objective: Prove independently that every Li coefficient is nonnegative, or localize the exact obstruction in the strongest candidate representation.
primary_candidate: Xian-Jin Li, A proof of the Riemann hypothesis, arXiv:0807.0090v10, 2025-10-14
candidate_chain: A1: Th is trace class and trace(Th)=Delta(h)-hhat(0)-hhat(1)
A2: construct gn,epsilon and hn,epsilon with hhat(0)=hhat(1)=0 and Delta(hn,epsilon)->2 lambda_n
A3: trace on ES(Q_Lambda_perp) equals zero
A4: VS(h) is a positive bounded operator
A5: trace on ES(Q_Lambda) is nonnegative
A7: pass epsilon->0 to conclude lambda_n>=0
independence_constraints: No step may assume RH, Li positivity, Weil positivity, or absence of off-line zeros.
Trace positivity must follow from a genuine positive operator or quadratic form on the declared Hilbert space.
Every restriction/compression and trace decomposition must be legally defined and trace class.
Every infinite group sum, basis sum, integral exchange, and limit must have an explicit convergence theorem.
The approximation Delta(hn,epsilon)->2 lambda_n must use exactly the same normalization as Contracts 04-05.
No preprint title, author identity, or arXiv posting counts as validation.
completion_criteria: all operator domains, adjoints, projections, trace-class properties, and convergence interchanges verified
formal or independently reproducible proof artifact produced
Contracts 03 and 05 close without adding assumptions
